description: Source code for Flash Circular Buffer (FCB) management in Zephyr OS, including functions for reading, writing, erasing, initializing, and managing flash sectors and FCB entries.

methods.name: fcb_get_align
methods.description: Returns the alignment of the flash area associated with the FCB.

methods.name: fcb_flash_read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified flash sector within the FCB.

methods.name: fcb_flash_write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified flash sector within the FCB.

methods.name: fcb_init
methods.description: Initializes the FCB with a given flash area ID.

methods.name: fcb_free_sector_cnt
methods.description: Returns the count of free sectors in the FCB.

methods.name: fcb_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the FCB is empty.

methods.name: fcb_put_len
methods.description: Encodes the length of an element for storage in flash.

methods.name: fcb_get_len
methods.description: Decodes the length of an element from flash data.

methods.name: fcb_sector_hdr_init
methods.description: Initializes a flash sector header for use.

methods.name: fcb_sector_hdr_read
methods.description: Reads and verifies the header of a flash sector.

methods.name: fcb_offset_last_n
methods.description: Finds the last N entries in the FCB.

methods.name: fcb_clear
methods.description: Clears the FCB by rotating sectors until empty.
